office_does: The Auditor runs elections, handles vehicle licenses and titles, keeps real estate records, provides passport services, and manages the county's financial operations, including budgeting, accounting and payroll.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Tillie Naputi-Pullar (Prefers Democratic Party) is the only candidate on the ballot. The seat is open: Auditor Mary Hall writes in the same pamphlet that this is her last election as County Auditor.

candidates.summary: Thurston County Elections Manager since 2013, running unopposed for the open Auditor seat as Mary Hall leaves office.
highlights: Elections Manager since 2013; in the Auditor's elections division since 1999 [S1]
Co-chair of the Secretary of State's VoteWA Advisory Board; state Elections Administrator of the Year in 2014 and 2021 [S1]
First-time candidate with no prior elected experience [S1]
